01 Input

02 Transformation

Applied rule

Difference = report − source. A row needs review when the absolute difference exceeds the chosen tolerance. The total difference is the sum of differences; tolerance changes only the classification, never the values.

→

03 Output

Initial sample reference

With zero tolerance in the initial sample: source 4,400.00, report 4,650.00 and difference +250.00, concentrated in 2026-02.

Take the task to your assistant

Locating a difference does not prove its cause. Filters, granularity, relationships, duplicates and recognition dates need evidence from the actual model.

Next steps in your environment

  1. Align the source and report's period, unit and filters.
  2. Locate periods that exceed tolerance.
  3. Investigate the cause using evidence before changing the measure.
Open free guide ↗

The guide and original packages are part of the free password-protected demo. If needed, you will be taken to login and then to your chosen task.

Prompt for your assistant

Reconcile [metric] between [authorized source] and [Power BI report] for [date range], with tolerance [amount]. Confirm units, filters, granularity and recognition rules before comparing. Deliver a table by period with source, report and report-minus-source differences. Separate discrepancies above tolerance, propose checks of filters, relationships and duplicates, and distinguish facts from hypotheses. Do not change measures without demonstrating the cause and preserving a reference against which to verify the result.
